channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: How to swap tokens from your wallet with cowswap
item.description: cowswap routes wallet token swaps through CoW Protocol batch auctions, where solvers settle trades with MEV protection and seek the best price across DEXs.

item.title: Solana Releases DvP Settlement Program With J.P. Morgan Input
item.description: Solana Foundation released an open-source settlement program shaped by J.P. Morgan input, aiming to let institutions swap assets and payment together on-chain.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake plans $1 million each for six House candidates and backs 26 more, as a Senate setback leaves crypto market rules unresolved before November’s midterms.

item.title: OKXICE files plan for 24/7 trading in over 60 stocks
item.description: OKXICE has filed plans for a 24/7 U.S. venue covering more than 60 tokenized stocks, a bid to bring blockchain-based share trading into regulated markets.

item.title: Five Decimal Checks for Cross-Chain Treasury Balances
item.description: Check token decimals, units and bridge records before comparing treasury balances across chains, so a display mismatch does not look like missing funds.

item.title: How to Trace BNB Chain Tokens From Pools to Wallets
item.description: Follow a pool swap, read token transfer events, and check each recipient address to see how BNB Chain tokens move from liquidity pools into wallets.

item.title: Will a BNB Chain Pool Handle Your Trade Size?
item.description: A BNB Chain pool can quote your trade and still deliver a worse price; check reserves, price impact, routing and slippage before you swap, because pool depth changes with every swap.

item.title: Check TRC-20 Details Before a Wallet Swap
item.description: Before swapping a TRC-20 token, match its network and contract address, check decimals and swap details, then confirm the wallet’s fee estimate on screen.

item.title: How Energy Is Shared Across Nested TRON Calls
item.description: Nested TRON calls share one transaction budget, but contracts can cover part of the cost. The call path, deployer limits and fee limit decide what the user pays.

item.title: What “Wrapped TRX” Means on a Swap Screen
item.description: Wrapped TRX labels can mean an interface step or a separate token contract; learn what your wallet will sign before choosing a swap route on TRON.

item.title: What BaseSwap V2 Pool Fees Mean for Liquidity Providers
item.description: BaseSwap V2 swap fees can add to LP returns, but volume, your share of the pool and token price moves decide whether providing liquidity pays off.

item.title: What Happens When a Destination Chain Does Not Support Your Token
item.description: A bridge transfer can fail when the destination chain has no matching token. Learn what happens, how routes handle it, and what to check before you send.

item.title: Why USDT Payouts on TRON Need an Energy Budget
item.description: A TRON USDT payout spends Energy at the sending address. The recipient’s token balance, resource coverage and fee fallback shape the budget more than the payout amount.

item.title: SEC proposes conditional crypto custody rules for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed new custody rules for advisers and funds, including conditional self-custody and state trust companies, which could widen access to crypto strategies.

item.title: ICBA sues OCC over crypto trust bank charter rules
item.description: A community-bank trade group sued the OCC over rules behind crypto trust charters, seeking to undo Protego’s approval and limit the regulator’s power.

item.title: How Long Does a Polygon PoS Withdrawal Stay Pending?
item.description: A Polygon PoS withdrawal often takes a few hours because it waits for an Ethereum checkpoint, then needs a separate claim transaction to finish.

item.title: How to Compare the Real Cost of Repeat Bridge Swaps
item.description: Repeat bridge swaps cost more than the quoted fee: compare route fees, slippage, gas, failed attempts and the value you receive before choosing a route.

item.title: Why Wrapped Tokens Stay Tied to Their Source
item.description: Wrapped tokens stay close to their source when each token is backed by a locked asset and redemption keeps that claim credible, but bridge design matters.

item.title: Bridge or Native Swap: How to Move BTC to ETH
item.description: For BTC to ETH, a bridge can give you bitcoin on Ethereum to trade, while a native swap aims to deliver ETH directly; compare fees, liquidity and trust.

item.title: How to Track an XMR-to-Ethereum Swap
item.description: An XMR-to-Ethereum swap can pause at several checkpoints. Learn how to tell whether Monero, the swap service or Ethereum is holding it up.
